wind.reason: KEIRIN official guidance identifies wind direction/speed as rider decision factors and cycling physics makes relative air speed directly affect aerodynamic drag. This does not establish incremental forecast value for race prediction.

admission_ladder: L0_NO_ENVIRONMENT: mandatory baseline; no wind/weather inputs.
L1_OBSERVED_WIND_PHYSICS_SENSITIVITY: outdoor venue only; observed, decision-available, provenance-bound wind may perturb physics in sensitivity worlds; no claim of predictive necessity.
L2_ENVIRONMENT_PREDICTIVE_ABLATION: future separately governed test only; compare predeclared no-environment vs observed-environment variants without tuning. Not authorized by this policy.
L3_OPERATIONAL_USE: prohibited until independent validation establishes stable material value and source-time transport reliability.

venue_rules.outdoor_venue: wind remains optional unless a later ablation demonstrates material predictive necessity
venue_rules.venue_station_mapping: must carry explicit provenance; proximity alone does not prove representativeness

what_is_established: Wind can affect cycling physics and KEIRIN tactics.
Weather forecasts have nonzero error and are not observations.
Observed environment can be represented safely with point-in-time provenance.
what_is_not_established: Wind materially improves race prediction beyond rider/line/tactical information.
Any forecast product is accurate enough to be a required race input.
